# Mashhood Rastgar — karachiwala.dev

> Mashhood Rastgar helps engineering organisations become agent-native. He works with
> executives and L&D teams at product and services companies on AI transformation,
> agentic engineering practice, and the engineering leadership required to make the
> shift stick. Based in Islamabad, Pakistan; works with teams internationally.

## What he does

He calls the practice **agentic engineering**: building the scaffolding, the guardrails
and the feedback loops that let AI agents do work a team would put its name on.

The problem he works on: teams adopt AI and start shipping more every week, but nobody
can tell whether the work is actually improving. The measure he uses instead of volume
is **intervention rate** — how often a human had to step in before a task was done.

In the organisations he works with, teams tend to split roughly three ways. About 20%
already have agents doing real work unsupervised. About 60% are using AI as a faster
autocomplete. About 20% are holding back, usually for defensible reasons around security
and legacy code. The constraint is not effort; it is that nobody tells the middle 60%
what good looks like.

## How to work with him

- **Keynotes and talks** — conferences and all-hands. What is actually changing in
  engineering, and what it means for the room.
- **Team workshops** — three days, hands on, run against the client's own codebase and
  backlog rather than a toy example.
- **Advisory** — ongoing, for executives making this shift at organisation level. A small
  number of engagements at a time.

Enquiries: hello@karachiwala.dev

## Background

- Head of Engineering at Taleemabad, the largest ed-tech company in Pakistan, scaling to
  thousands of public schools and millions of children.
- Google Developer Expert for Machine Learning and AI, and for Web.
- Previously led engineering at Sastaticket.pk, Pakistan's largest travel platform.
- Founded Recurship, a studio building products for startups.
- First full-stack engineer at Testmunk, acquired by Snapchat in 2016.
- Has worked with Novo Nordisk, Contour Software, Arbisoft, Metamorphic AI and LUMS.
